title: Homeschool Hours & Attendance Tracker – Spreadsheet + Printable PDF for up to 5 Kids
description: Record homeschool hours and attendance in one bundle. The Excel / Google Sheets workbook auto-totals hours for up to 5 kids, with monthly summaries, a family dashboard and a 12-month attendance calendar. The 23-page printable PDF (A4 & US Letter) adds monthly hour logs, annual goals, reading log and a year-end summary. You enter your own goals; no state presets. Instant download.

title: Printable Homeschool Hour Log – Monthly Core & Non-Core Hours with Year-to-Date Total
description: 12 monthly hour log pages (August to July) for homeschool record keeping. Write each subject's hours in weekly columns, tick Core or Non-core, then fill the subtotals, monthly attendance counts and a year-to-date box. Includes a filled-in example month. Part of a 23-page PDF in A4 and US Letter, plus an auto-totalling Excel / Google Sheets workbook. Instant download.

title: Homeschool Record Keeping Printables & Spreadsheet – Hours, Attendance, Reading Log, Portfolio
description: What's inside: an Excel / Google Sheets workbook with a daily log (drop-down lists), Kid 1-5 summaries, a family dashboard with a 'Behind pace' flag, a 12-month attendance calendar and a printable year-end report.
